chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn Dhuwayl, from Muqātil ibn Muqātil, who said:

I said to al-Riḍā عليه السلام: “May I be your ransom, teach me a supplication for the fulfillment of needs.” He said: “When you have an important need to Allah, the Exalted, then perform ghusl and wear your cleanest clothes.” And he mentioned the hadith.

key_terms.أَنْظَفَ ثِيَابِكَ: your cleanest clothes, worn as part of proper devotional etiquette
key_terms.حَاجَةٌ: a need or matter sought from Allah
key_terms.دُعَاءً: a supplication made to Allah for one's need
key_terms.فَاغْتَسِلْ: perform ghusl as preparation before supplication
key_terms.لِقَضَاءِ الْحَوَائِجِ: for the fulfillment of needs and requests

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام teach for seeking the fulfillment of an important need from Allah?
ai.summary: This narration reports a request to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام for a du'a to fulfill needs. He instructs that when one has an important need before Allah, one should perform ghusl and wear the cleanest garments, indicating preparation and reverence in turning to Allah through supplication.
